title: SDGym - Synthetic Data Gym
summary: A framework from the Data to AI Lab at MIT for benchmarking synthetic data generators on non-temporal tabular data, providing demo synthesizers and a benchmark() scoring pipeline. This repository is a fork of the original DAI-Lab/SDGym project, vendoring its own CTGAN- and TVAE-based synthesizer implementations and benchmark harness in-tree.
evidence: sdgym/synthesizers/ctgan.py defines CTGANSynthesizer; sdgym/synthesizers/tvae.py defines TVAESynthesizer; setup.py url points to DAI-Lab/SDGym
needs: This repository appears to be a direct fork of the original DAI-Lab/SDGym project itself (first-party SDV-family work), not a third-party consumer; flagging since importance 6 is reserved and unavailable here.
